The FloPlast 110mm push-fit adjustable bend is a vital component for soil and vent drainage systems, offering flexible angular adjustments from 0 to 90°. Manufactured from durable polypropylene, this black pipe bend ensures a robust and long-lasting installation, ideal for intricate pipework configurations in various drainage projects. Its double socket design and push-fit system, complete with reliable ring seal joints, facilitate quick and secure connections without solvent welding, saving valuable time on site. This bend provides an efficient solution for plumbers and builders seeking adaptable drainage fittings. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
